description: This Dart source file defines theming for a Flutter application, specifically for an admin panel. It provides color tokens, text themes, and ThemeData configuration for light and dark themes, including customization of various UI components like AppBar, Card, InputDecoration, and Buttons.

methods.name: buildAdminThemeLight
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured for light mode for the admin panel.

methods.name: buildAdminThemeDark
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured for dark mode for the admin panel.

methods.name: buildAdminTheme
methods.description: Provides a backward-compatible way to get the default theme, currently returning the light theme.
